musl-math.license: MIT (COPYRIGHT; the math sources carry the permissive notices of FreeBSD msun/Sun Microsystems and of the ARM Optimized Routines)
musl-math.use: <math.h> and the algorithms of the static C runtime of ARM64 applications (sdk/crt): the stream layer and the printf and scanf families, number conversion, strings, wide and multibyte characters, character classes, dates as text, sorting, the allocator (mallocng) and its locks; linked into programs built with the SDK, never into the host

pl_mpeg.license: MIT (SPDX-License-Identifier in pl_mpeg.h and the statement in README.md; upstream ships no separate licence file)
pl_mpeg.use: MPEG-1 video and MP2 audio decoder of the sample player sdk/samples/player; linked into that program, never into the host

libcxx.use: the C++ standard library of ARM64 applications; headers and sources, built into cxx.lib by tools/arm64_sdk.py and linked statically into programs built with the SDK, never into the host

libcxxabi.use: the C++ ABI runtime of ARM64 applications (exceptions, RTTI, guards, operator new); part of cxx.lib

libunwind.use: the unwinder interface of the C++ ABI over the exception handling of Windows (RaiseException, RtlUnwindEx); part of cxx.lib

llvm-libc.version: LLVM libc 21.1.8, the headers libc++ builds std::from_chars for floating point with (llvmorg-21.1.8)
llvm-libc.use: headers only, included by one source of libc++ (charconv.cpp); LLVM releases them only inside the whole source archive, so each file is pinned by its own SHA-256 in sdk/llvm-libc-files.json

tzdata.use: IANA text data for libc++ chrono; install build/sdk/share/tzdata in C:\WINDOWS\TZDATA or set NEO98_TZDIR

compiler-rt.use: 128-bit division compiler helpers required by libc++ filesystem clocks; built unchanged into cxx.lib
